risks.risk: The bike may have mechanical issues such as worn chain, brakes, or gears not working as advertised.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the chain, brake pads, and gear shift mechanism in operation.

risks.risk: The bike may have hidden damage or rust not visible in the photo, especially under the frame or in the drivetrain.
risks.proof: Photos of the frame underside, chainstay, and bottom bracket area, and a close-up of the drivetrain and pedals.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential hidden damage

risks.risk: The bike may not be in original condition with missing parts or accessories.
risks.proof: Photos of all components including handlebars, pedals, and any included accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up video or photos of the chain, brakes, and gears in operation.
Photos of the frame underside, chainstay, and bottom bracket area.
Photos of all components including handlebars, pedals, and accessories.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
